title: The D.B. Cooper Mystery
author: Shraf
description:
On November 24, 1971, an ordinary-looking man boarded a commercial airplane in Portland, Oregon, using the name Dan Cooper. He appeared calm, dressed in a business suit, and carried a briefcase. Nobody aboard the aircraft could have imagined that this passenger would soon become one of America's most mysterious criminals.

During the flight, the man informed a flight attendant that he had a bomb. He demanded $200,000 in cash and four parachutes. Surprisingly, his demands were met. After releasing the passengers in Seattle, he ordered the aircraft to take off again. Somewhere between Seattle and Reno, he jumped from the rear of the airplane with the ransom money and disappeared into the darkness.

Despite an extensive FBI investigation, hundreds of interviews, and decades of speculation, his real identity and ultimate fate remain unknown.

This two-part true crime series explores the daring hijacking, the mysterious parachute escape, the evidence left behind, and the theories surrounding one of America's most fascinating unsolved criminal cases.

Did D.B. Cooper successfully escape, or did he disappear into the wilderness forever?

But the holidays are coming up again, and you know what that means; more trouble in paradise and cold-blooded murder. 
This Christmas, Cameron Stack, Mackenzie's biggest client, has been asked to represent the Candy Cane Network on their exclusive luxury cruise liner. The stars of the Candy Cane Network will entertain their fans and wealthy guests as they sail around the Artic Circle over Christmas and see the amazing Northern Lights. Mackenzie and Nick accompany Cameron and his boyfriend, Kevin, in order to make sure everything goes smoothly and to get in a little Holiday Honeymoon while they have the time. 
But as the cruise sets sail, danger lurks around every corner. Soon after departure, a passenger is brutally killed and animosities rise to the surface as a slew of suspects is uncovered. Can Mackenzie Monroe solve the mystery before someone else gets hurt? Or worse, before she meets her perilous end at the bottom of the ocean?
The Evergreen Murders A Mackenzie Monroe Christmas Mystery Season 4 Holiday Honeymoon premieres Tuesday, November 24th with five brand-new episodes. But you can listen to all three previous seasons, The Evergreen Murders, Murder at Mistletoe Manor and Return to Evergreen wherever you get your podcasts. And also make sure to check out our sister podcast, Christmas Around the World, showcasing wonderful holiday traditions, people and cultures from places like Western Europe, Africa, the Middle East, India, the United States, and more! See you November 24th and thank you so much for listening.

What Is an Aged PayPal Account?

An aged PayPal account is an account that was created some time ago and has existed for months or years. Sellers may advertise accounts that are several months, one year, or multiple years old.

The term “aged” describes the account's history, not necessarily its current condition.

An older account is not automatically more trustworthy, more secure, or better suited to business transactions than a newly created account.

What Does a Verified PayPal Account Mean?

A verified PayPal account is generally one for which certain required information or payment methods have been confirmed. The precise verification requirements depend on the account, its features, and PayPal's applicable policies.

For US users, verification may involve steps such as:


  • Confirming an email address or mobile phone number.
  • Linking and confirming an eligible bank account.
  • Linking an eligible debit or credit card.
  • Providing identity or business information when requested.
  • Completing additional checks required by PayPal.

Verification does not guarantee unlimited transactions, instant withdrawals, or freedom from account reviews.

Why Do Sellers Advertise Aged and Verified Accounts?

Third-party sellers often promote aged accounts by claiming that they offer benefits such as:

  • Access to an account that has already completed certain verification steps.

This audiobook isn’t just about motivation; it’s a roadmap to understanding how your beliefs shape your reality.

"He Can Who Thinks He Can" offers a unique blend of inspiration and practical advice, making it a must-listen for anyone eager to transform their mindset and achieve their dreams. Discover the power of your thoughts and become the architect of your own success.

title: The Informed Position
author: Henrik Lundberg and Tripp Davis
description: Two Indiana University finance students break down markets in public. Weekly Recap (Saturdays): the week in markets: the Fed, rates, earnings, credit and global macro. Deep Dive (Wednesdays): one company, industry or asset class, taken apart with fundamental, technical and quantitative analysis. Plus occasional guest episodes: someone from the field takes the lead while we dig into who they are, what they do and what they're watching. Opinion and education only, not investment advice. Topics, corrections or questions: theinformedposition@gmail.com

title: The Second Act Daily
author: Dr. Eric Davis
description: Join Dr. Eric Davis for daily morning reflections on fitness, faith, leadership, and personal growth. The Second Act Daily is designed to help listeners strengthen mind, body, spirit, and leadership while building their next chapter, one day at a time.

title: Where Does the Bible Come From?
author: Peter Wyetzner
description: How the Bible developed into its current form; how it was translated and interpreted; and how it has influenced the cultural history of the West.

title: Faith and Fables Podcast
author: Meagan Robertson
description: Are you tired of books that make you blush, characters that make you cringe, and stories that put you to sleep? Well, you've come to the right place. This is where we recommend clean and exciting reads, make new bookish friends, and discuss all the details of the stories we love from a Christian perspective (spoiler free, of course!). Join Meagan on the Faith and Fables Podcast!

title: Rumbling Wings (Tales of the Iroquois Heritage)
author: Arthur C. Parker
description:
When a sacred feather goes missing from the Nunda Waga Nation, a young warrior named Tayanita embarks on a perilous quest that uncovers ancient truths and challenges his understanding of loyalty and identity. In "Rumbling Wings," Arthur C. Parker weaves a rich tapestry of Iroquois culture, revealing the intricacies of the League of the Iroquois—the Men of Men—and the vibrant traditions that shape their world. Tayanita must navigate the delicate balance between tradition and change, facing not only external challenges but also the inner turmoil of his own beliefs.

As tensions rise within the tribe and whispers of betrayal echo through the forest, Tayanita's journey becomes a powerful exploration of heritage, responsibility, and the bonds that unite a community. Listeners will be captivated by the vivid storytelling that brings to life the customs, rituals, and struggles of a people deeply connected to their land and history.

Can Tayanita restore the feather and reconcile the conflicting forces at play in his life? Join him as he encounters wise elders, fierce rivals, and the spirits of his ancestors, all while discovering what it truly means to be a protector of his people. "Rumbling Wings" is not just a tale of adventure; it's an invitation to explore the heart of a culture and the enduring spirit of its people. Perfect for those fascinated by indigenous narratives and the richness of cultural heritage, this audiobook promises to ignite curiosity and inspire reflection.

title: The Wealth of Humanity
author: Mark Steven Hewitt
description:
Audio discussions and summaries of Mark Steven Hewitt's book The Wealth of Humanity: Together We Prosper.
Long before money, the people who lived along the Indus survived the ice ages with stone, fire, knowledge and each other. Their wealth was what they knew and what they shared, and they handed it from one generation to the next.
Each episode follows a thread of that inheritance: the first villages at Mehrgarh and the cities of the Indus; Adam Smith's wealth of nations and the five kinds of wealth that money alone cannot measure; a country taking stock of its energy, water, minerals, health and learning; and how the people of a place can plan, build and keep what they build so that it outlasts its founders.
Insight into the development of a truly regenerative future. Together we prosper; apart we fail.
Read the book free: https://BookHip.com/CVZXWCZ
Episodes, notes and transcripts: https://podcasts.nationsoflight.com
All of Mark's books: https://nationsoflight.com
From The Lydian Foundation, the platform arm of The Tribernachi Foundation. The discussions are AI-generated from the manuscript, and Mark's introductions and closings use an AI clone of his voice; each episode says so in its notes.

title: The Tōkaidō Nights: Sleep Stories from Old Japan
author: The Tōkaidō Nights
description:
Fall asleep on the old Tōkaidō road. Each night, one Edo-period post town between Edo and Kyoto: a slow, quiet story that fades out after about 35 minutes, then rain on the thatch, a low fire and a temple bell on the hour. Nothing dramatic happens, on purpose. No music. 53 nights to Kyoto.
The narration voice is AI; the stories are made and checked for history by a Japanese creator. Not medical advice, only company for the night.
Video version: youtube.com/@TokaidoNights

title: The Relationship Room
author: Victoria Dukuly
description: Welcome to The Relationship Room, where we have honest conversations about relationships, identity, boundaries, communication, and the decisions that shape our lives. Hosted by Ms. Victoria of Identity First Relationship Coaching, this podcast offers thoughtful perspectives, real-life insight, and God-centered wisdom without judgment. Whether we're discussing love, dating, marriage, forgiveness, or personal growth, the goal is to challenge perspectives, encourage self-reflection, and help you recognize what deserves your attention. Pull up a seat, join the conversation, and let's get into it!

title: The Science of Getting Rich (Practical Guide to Wealth)
author: Wallace D. Wattles
description:
In "The Science of Getting Rich," Wallace D. Wattles reveals a revolutionary principle: your thoughts, when infused with gratitude, can attract wealth and transform your life. This audiobook isn't just a guide; it’s a blueprint for unlocking the financial abundance that lies within your grasp. Wattles dives deep into the connection between mindset and monetary success, challenging you to rethink your beliefs about wealth and prosperity.

As you listen, you’ll uncover practical strategies that empower you to shift your mental framework. Wattles emphasizes the importance of taking deliberate actions to create opportunities, urging you to cultivate a mindset that draws abundance towards you. He tackles common misconceptions about wealth, showing that rich living isn't just for the select few but is attainable for anyone willing to embrace these transformative ideas.

Expect to embark on a journey that combines science with self-help, where every chapter builds on the last, leading you toward a more prosperous version of yourself. With its straightforward language and practical applications, this audiobook will engage you, challenge your thinking, and inspire you to take action. Whether you're seeking a financial turnaround or simply curious about the principles of abundance, "The Science of Getting Rich" offers you the tools to create a life filled with wealth and fulfillment. You won't want to miss this enlightening experience that promises to change how you view money and success forever.

title: The Christian Mission Podcast
author: The Christian Mission
description: The Christian Mission Podcast is about faith, life, and trying to follow Christ in the Modern World. This podcast explores my Christian journey through everyday life, Scripture, church teachings, struggles, growth, and conversations about purpose, discipline, and becoming the person God calls us to be.

title: The Untroubled Mind (Finding Peace Within)
author: Herbert J. Hall
description:
Dr. Herbert J. Hall dives deep into the chaos of the human mind, tackling the relentless worries, fears, and anxieties that plague us all. In "The Untroubled Mind," he offers a fresh perspective on how to transform a turbulent mental landscape into a place of peace and clarity. Through engaging stories from his medical practice and insightful research, Hall illuminates the hidden mechanisms of our thoughts and emotions, revealing the roots of our worries and how they tie into our conscience.

But this isn't just another self-help book filled with generic advice. Hall challenges listeners to confront their mental patterns head-on, guiding them through practical exercises designed to quiet the mind and cultivate a more serene existence. What insights can you unlock about your own thought processes? How can you learn to navigate the storm within?

As you journey through this audiobook, you'll discover effective strategies to reclaim control over your thoughts and foster a lasting sense of calm. Hall's compassionate approach reassures listeners that they are not alone in their struggles, inviting them to embark on a transformative path toward mental tranquility. Dive in, and find out how to harness the power of your mind to create the peace you deserve. Are you ready to reshape your inner dialogue and embrace a more untroubled life?

My grandfather penned letters of complaint and praise to many businesses, newspapers and politicians.
He called this activity "stirring the possum". When he died, his letters were passed on to me. There are some absolute beauties.

title: The Astonishing Adventure of Jane Smith (Secrets and Intrigue)
author: Patricia Wentworth
description:
Jane Smith never expected that a chance encounter on a park bench would turn her life upside down. Homeless and nearly broke, she stumbles into a web of intrigue that pulls her into a world of secret passages, government experiments, and shady characters. As she navigates this dangerous landscape, Jane must rely on her quick thinking and daring choices to survive. Will she uncover the truth behind the mysterious forces at play, or will she become another victim of the shadows?

In 'The Astonishing Adventure of Jane Smith,' award-winning author Patricia Wentworth crafts a thrilling tale that blends crime and romance, immersing listeners in a suspenseful journey. Each twist and turn reveals not just the challenges Jane faces, but also the strength she didn't know she had. As secrets unfold, the stakes rise, and Jane finds unexpected allies along the way.

Join Jane on her transformative quest, where every decision could lead her closer to redemption or deeper into danger. This audiobook invites you to explore the complexities of human resilience and the lengths one will go to uncover the truth. Get ready to be captivated by a story that promises both excitement and heart, leaving you eager for each episode of Jane's astonishing adventure.

title: Say Yeah with Mr Motivator
author: Mr Motivator

Say Yeah with Mr Motivator brings inspiring, honest conversations to help you feel good, think differently and live life with more energy. 
Mr Motivator sits down with experts, familiar faces and real people to explore health, happiness, confidence, resilience, nutrition, movement and the choices that help us thrive. 
From powerful personal stories to practical advice you can use every day, expect warmth, wisdom, laughter and Mr M’s signature positivity, all wrapped up in conversations that leave you ready to say yeah to life.

Hosted by Bucks Business Leader Tina Duggan, we meet the owners, entrepreneurs and people behind the businesses to talk successes, challenges, mistakes and lessons learned along the way.
Real people. Real stories. Useful advice. No corporate spin.
Business Laid Bare — a Bucks Radio Podcast.

title: Read Law Right

description: Read Law Write is a podcast for law students who want to improve their understanding, analysis and evaluation. Through practical discussions of legal study, reasoning, reading, writing and professional skills, each episode explores how to become a more confident and effective law student without outsourcing the hard thinking that legal education is designed to develop.

description:
This podcast covers all aspects to the Estate Planners functions including the client appointment, follow-up, drafting, attestations, registrations and concluding the service. It will explore key cases and look at client case studies for wills, trusts, Lasting Powers of Attorney and probate.

title: The Rejuvenation of Aunt Mary (A Young Scapegrace's Redemption)
author: Anne Warner
description:
When Jack Watkins, Jr. overhears his lady-love whispering sweet nothings to another man, he spirals into a wild escapade that lands him on the brink of expulsion from college. This time, Aunt Mary, his beloved great-aunt, has had enough of his antics and decides to cut him off. With his future hanging by a thread and his inheritance slipping away, Jack must navigate a series of hilarious misadventures to win back Aunt Mary's favor.

Join Jack as he teams up with a motley crew of friends, each with their own quirks and schemes, as they concoct outrageous plans to prove he’s worthy of redemption. From misguided attempts at charm to laugh-out-loud blunders, their journey reveals the true meaning of family, loyalty, and the lengths one will go to for love.

In "The Rejuvenation of Aunt Mary," Anne Warner crafts a delightful tale filled with humor and heart, exploring themes of forgiveness and self-discovery. Will Jack manage to mend his ways and win back Aunt Mary’s trust? Or will his shenanigans lead him further down a path of chaos? Tune in to experience a rollercoaster of emotions and laughter as Jack learns that sometimes, the best way to grow is through a little mischief and a lot of love.

title: MYSTICA

description:
Welcome to MYSTICA ꩜

Through personal revelations, sacred transmissions and explorations of the female nervous system, the unseen and ancient feminine wisdom, we discover the art of cultivating our vital life force.

"The Real Women in Tech" is dedicated to discussing real stories from women across various roles, functions, and seniority in the tech industry. While there are many podcasts out there, our unique approach lies in our group discussions. author: Candace
description:
God Family Country — Faith, Family, and the American Spirit

Welcome to God Family Country, a podcast built on the belief that God comes first, family is a blessing, and country is worth standing up for. This is a place for honest conversations about faith, family values, patriotism, and the principles that make our nation strong.

Together, we'll explore the power of faith, the importance of raising strong families, the challenges facing America, and the timeless values that guide us through life's struggles. Whether we're talking about God, the Bible, everyday life, or the future of our country, our goal is to encourage, inspire, and remind people of what truly matters.

If you believe in putting God first, protecting family values, and loving the country we call home, you're in the right place.

God First. Family Always. Country Forever.

Join the conversation, stand firm in your faith, and be part of the movement to bring faith, family, and American values back to the forefront.

title: The Million-Dollar Suitcase (Chasing a Master Thief)
author: Alice MacGowan
description:
When bank teller Leo Hartman makes off with nearly a million dollars, he turns a seemingly simple heist into a high-stakes game of cat and mouse. Private detective Jerry Boyne is determined to track him down, but when Leo disappears from his seventh-floor apartment, the chase intensifies. With a suitcase full of cash and a trail that leads to dead ends, the clock ticks as Boyne must unravel the mystery of Leo's vanishing act.

Partnering with the brilliant Barbara Wallace, whose keen observational skills rival those of Sherlock Holmes, Boyne dives deeper into a web of deceit and danger. Together, they uncover hidden secrets and unexpected alliances, but every clue they follow leads them further into a labyrinth of crime, betrayal, and moral ambiguity.

As they navigate the dark underbelly of the city, listeners will experience the thrilling tension of a detective's pursuit while grappling with the ethical dilemmas that arise in a world where everyone has something to hide. Will Boyne and Barbara catch the elusive thief, or will they fall victim to a conspiracy far more complex than they ever imagined? Get ready for a gripping journey through deception, clever twists, and a race against time in 'The Million-Dollar Suitcase.' This audiobook is sure to keep you guessing until the very last moment.

title: Parenting Strengths™ Podcast
author: Phil Bacalia
description:
Parenting is one of life's greatest responsibilities—and one of its greatest challenges. But what if becoming a better parent begins with understanding yourself?
Welcome to the Parenting Strengths™ Podcast, hosted by author and speaker Phil Bacalia.
Through biblical wisdom, practical insights, and honest conversations, we'll explore the attitudes, instincts, and everyday decisions that shape our parenting. From building stronger relationships to preparing children for independence, each episode offers encouragement and actionable ideas for raising children with greater purpose and confidence

title: ELAB Leadership: Leading Without Losing Yourself
author: Shalimar Ali El
description: Real, raw, and authentic conversations about leadership, trauma, healing, and transformation. Through honest stories and heartfelt dialogue, we explore what happens when we stop pretending we have it all together, take off the mask, and begin the journey toward wholeness. Because the most powerful leaders aren't perfect, they're healing. ❤️ This is leadership reimagined. This is leadership restored.

author: Youlanda Burnett
description: As I reach a pivotal point in my life, I realize I have more days behind me than in front of me.  This podcast is for mature women (or men), mostly women.  Like me, you may be aging gracefully, in an empty nest, or just growing out of an old marriage.  I want to share some of my struggles and my successes.  My mental breakdowns, finding myself again, and some other stories also. This podcast is also about my growth as an individual, not as someone's mom, wife, or grandmother -- just me.

Hello everyone! Welcome to The Founding Mothers of Hot and Talking Podcast! We are your hosts, Valerie O'Brien and Jamie McMaster. Each week, join us as we deep dive into a new topic. title: Coffee Break
author: GovContractPros
description:
Join GovContractPros for a fresh perspective on the ever-changing world of federal government contracting.

A GCP Coffee Break: GovCon in Focus breaks down the policies, regulations, legislative developments, and industry news shaping the federal marketplace.

Hosted by David Mullis, Regulatory Affairs Consultant at GovContractPros, the podcast brings timely analysis, practical insights, and candid conversations about the issues that matter most to government contractors.

From SBA programs and small business regulations to federal acquisition reform, compliance requirements, and emerging policy changes, each episode takes a closer look at what's happening in Washington, why it matters, and how it could affect your business.

Featuring insights from GovContractPros experts, industry leaders, and special guests, A GCP Coffee Break goes beyond the headlines to connect federal policy with real-world contracting challenges and opportunities.

Whether you're a small business owner, government contractor, industry advocate, or federal acquisition professional, this is your opportunity to stay informed without getting lost in the regulatory weeds.

Your GovCon briefing for the issues that matter.

title: One of Those Songs
author: Kollin
description:
One of Those Songs is a music podcast that explores the songs that become part of our lives. Hosted by DEK of Hearts, the three-part harmony country-pop trio known for their unforgettable four-chair turn on NBC's The Voice, each episode takes a closer look at the stories, memories, and moments that make certain songs impossible to forget.
Through conversations with artists, songwriters, and music lovers, One of Those Songs uncovers the inspiration behind the music we love and the impact it has on our lives. Featuring special guests, live performances, and behind-the-scenes stories from across the country music world, the podcast celebrates the songs that connect us, inspire us, and stay with us long after the last note.
Whether it's a song that reminds you of home, helped you through heartbreak, or changed the course of your life, everyone has one of those songs.

---

About DEK of Hearts
DEK of Hearts is a Nashville-based three-part harmony country-pop trio featuring Dylan John, Emily Clapp, and Kollin Bailey. The group gained national attention with a four-chair turn on NBC's The Voice, earning praise from coaches Reba McEntire, Michael Bublé, Snoop Dogg, and Niall Horan before ultimately joining Team Niall.

Since then, the trio has continued building a loyal following through its powerful harmonies, engaging live performances, and passion for storytelling. From performing on the historic Grand Ole Opry stage and sharing the stage with artists such as Carly Pearce to writing with some of Nashville's most iconic songwriters and releasing original music of their own, DEK of Hearts brings that same love of music and connection to One of Those Songs, exploring the stories behind the songs that shape our lives.

Because everyone has one of those songs.

title: African Myths (Traditions and Storytelling)
author: Carter Woodson
description:
Carter Woodson unveils the vibrant tapestry of African storytelling through a collection of captivating myths that have shaped cultures for centuries. With each tale, listeners will journey into the heart of Africa, where ancient wisdom and moral lessons intertwine in unforgettable narratives. Discover the clever trickster, the wise elder, and the fierce warrior as they navigate challenges that resonate with both young and old.

These stories are not just entertainment; they serve as a vital link to the past, preserving the traditions and values of generations. Woodson’s work emphasizes the role of professional storytellers, revered figures who traverse villages, sharing these rich narratives that teach, inspire, and ignite the imagination. As you listen, you’ll uncover themes of resilience, community, and the eternal struggle between good and evil, all woven into the fabric of daily life.

Each myth invites curiosity and reflection, enticing you to explore the deeper meanings behind the characters' journeys. What lessons will emerge from the shadows of the past? How do these ancient tales continue to influence modern thought? Engage with the stories that have captivated audiences for ages, and immerse yourself in the wisdom of African culture. 'African Myths' is more than just a collection of stories; it’s a celebration of heritage, a call to remember, and an exploration of identity through the power of narrative.

title: PsycheMD: Extraordinary Stories Of The Human Mind

title: Cedar Valley Dark Side
author: Kaleb Carda
description:
Have you ever wondered about the haunted history of your town? Are you fascinated by ghost stories, unexplained mysteries, local legends, and the eerie tales hiding in your own backyard? Welcome to Cedar Valley Dark Side, a bi-weekly podcast exploring the spooky, mysterious, and supernatural side of the Cedar Valley in Iowa.

Hosted by Kaleb Carda, Cedar Valley Dark Side dives into local ghost stories, Iowa folklore, paranormal encounters, haunted locations, and forgotten legends from across the Cedar Valley. Through intriguing storytelling connected to these tales, we uncover the stories you might never hear about in everyday life.

As someone fascinated by ghosts, folklore, and the unexplained, host Kaleb Carda has collected stories and legends from the Cedar Valley to give listeners a fresh perspective on the communities they call home. From eerie encounters and mysterious local history to chilling folklore passed down through generations, each episode invites you to explore the hidden side of your town.

Whether you're a lifelong paranormal enthusiast, a fan of scary stories, or simply curious about the mysteries surrounding Cedar Falls, Waterloo, and the greater Cedar Valley, there's something here for you.

Discover the legends. Explore the unexplained. Uncover the stories hiding in the Cedar Valley.

Listen to Cedar Valley Dark Side on Spotify, and uncover a side of Iowa you may never have known existed.

author: India Smith
description:
This is simply a space to slow down for a minute.
⠀

title: Breaking Free From The Inner Critic: The Underlying Cause of All Addictions and Emotional Problems by by Kalie Marino
author: Momentum Media Advertising
description: What if the voice in your head, the one that nitpicks, compares, and catastrophizes, is the root beneath every other struggle you've tried to fix? Across eight episodes, this season follows clinical social worker and interfaith minister Kalie Marino as she names the hidden addiction she calls critical addiction, traces where it comes from, and walks you through the Four Steps to Freedom. You'll move from living under your Inner Critic's rule to forgiveness, gratitude, and a real, practical peace.  You'll learn to spot the drug-like traits of habitual faultfinding and recognize the ten coping strategies, from perfectionism and sarcasm to worry and substance abuse, that only mask it. You'll practice the four steps: notice and name your Inner Critic, devalue negativity, release it and choose peace, and replace disempowering "why" questions with empowering ones. Along the way, you'll see why resisting a habit feeds it, how shifting your identity beats white-knuckling your behavior, and how to tell discernment from judgment. You'll also explore the difference between head-mind and heart-mind, build an emotional vocabulary, and use forgiveness and gratitude as your shortcuts to freedom.  This season is for the self-aware striver who has tried to quit the habit, the worry, or the anger and found something else rushing in to take its place. It's for readers and listeners who are tired of being hard on themselves and everyone around them, and who suspect the real problem runs deeper than any single symptom. If you're ready to trade being right for being happy, this journey was made for you.

title: From Dusk To Shawn
author: Shawn
description:
I've retired from the government, but I am actually here to help. This is a discovery of myself and a document of my life for my children. Come as I and guests discuss what it took for me to overcome some of my life issues. 

A recent diagnosis changed my life after a long military career; one whose implications might change yours.  And there is a saying that the later in life you find out, and the longer you are, the more Autistic you become.  

Hello new me.  What a horrible nightmare to wake up into.  I get a bit all over the place, but I try to bring it back round.  Be patient, I am documenting crazy in progress.  

Dusk is where I was, and my journey is a new one.

Come along as I tell you my life story and lessons learned.  I promise, this is a story worth telling from someone willing to be honest in all aspects of life.  Allow me to paint the whole picture before throwing stones through it. 

I hope I may leave the world a better place and to break the ancestral absurdities we call traditions that harm rather than help our next generation, our society, ourselves.  

We CAN have progress as well as conserve the parts of the past worthy of our own discretion.  To honor the past for what it is; a long series of lessons we would do well to revisit and not lie about.

We CAN have a healthy support of those around us who understand we all have our walks of life we have to make.  To have patience and caring and be able to expect it back.

Live or Die.  That is what the meaning of life is.  This podcast will help you to die a little before you really learn to live again.  There is no hope of gain of anything from you but to help make a better world for my kids.  By butterfly effect in hope that I can enrichen yours as well.  

My children have suffered enough at my hands(metaphorically speaking) and now I work to rebuild what I have helped to cause. 

If you have ever wanted to hear a raw and unedited dramatic life experience tell, come join as I do as many entries as I am able into this audio diary.  

I hope to be able to change your perspective to one of a better world without changing anything other than the window you are using to look out of your home from. 

We all need support.  We all need this discussion.  

This is wholly my financial burden.

As Kirk navigates treacherous alliances and confronts a formidable enemy, listeners will be drawn into a high-stakes journey where every decision could alter the course of history. The conflict escalates not just in space but within the hearts of those who must choose between duty and personal sacrifice. With advanced technology, space battles, and moral dilemmas at every turn, this audiobook explores the complexities of leadership and the cost of war.

Join Kirk and his crew as they uncover hidden truths and face unexpected challenges that test their resolve. Will they manage to thwart the impending conflict, or will their mission lead to unforeseen consequences? With its dynamic characters and gripping narrative, 'Battle for the Stars' invites listeners to explore the depths of human resilience in the face of an interstellar crisis. title: Formula 1: History and Legends
author: baradellopublishing@proton.me
description:
Your heart rate quickens; in the distance, you hear the deep, muffled rumble of a V12 engine coming to life... then, silence. Welcome: I will be your guide on this journey to the very limits of physics. This is not your typical sports report about who crossed the finish line first last Sunday. Formula 1 is much more than a sport—it is an open-air technological laboratory, a saga defined by extreme engineering, visceral rivalries, legendary triumphs, and dramatic moments that have shaped history. Over the course of these ten episodes, I will take you straight into the cockpit, behind the scenes in the pit garages, and into the heart of the paddock’s most closely guarded secrets. From the humble, dusty beginnings of the 1950s to the hybrid single-seaters that look like spaceships...
Episode Index

Episode 1: The Origins - From the Ashes of War to the Circuits of Glory (The first GP at
Silverstone in 1950).
Episode 2: The Drake and the Red - The Birth of an Immortal Myth (Enzo Ferrari's life,
philosophy, and obsession).
Episode 3: The English Revolution - When the Engine Ends Up... Behind! (Colin
Chapman's and Cooper's intuition).
Episode 4: The Golden Age and Risk - Heroes Without Fear (The 1970s amid extreme
speeds, danger, and Jackie Stewart's battle).
Episode 5: Fire and Ice - The Legend of Hunt and Lauda (The 1976 duel and the dramatic
Nürburgring crash).
Episode 6: The Era of the Titans - Prost, Senna, and Total War (The psychological and
sporting rivalry between Alain Prost and Ayrton Senna).
Episode 7: The Black Saturday of Imola - The Turning Point of Modern Safety (The tragic
1994 weekend and the revolution for driver protection).
Episode 8: The Kaiser and the Red Domination - Michael Schumacher and the Ferrari
Legend (Team reconstruction and 5 consecutive world titles).
Episode 9: F1 in the Hybrid Era - Silent Power and Generational Records (Turbo-hybrid
engines from 2014 and Sir Lewis Hamilton's record era).
Episode 10: The Future of the Circus - Global Entertainment and New Frontiers (Netflix's
media boom, Drive to Survive, and new generations).
Episode 11 (Special): The Triumph of the Tricolore - Kimi Antonelli and the Italy of Talents
(Celebrating Andrea Kimi Antonelli's victory and Italy as a cradle of racing talents).

description:
Welcome to the Gossip Salon Podcast, where the gossip is good, the conversations are honest and NOTHING is off limits! ☕️

title: koalamoonfm
author: koalamoonfm
description: Koala Moon is a human-made bedtime story channel created to help children feel safe, calm and ready for sleep. Every story is written by Luke Prendergast, Annabel Pitcher or a specially selected guest writer, read aloud by host and Co-Creator Abbe Opher, produced by Holly, engineered by Sokratis, and brought to YouTube by George and Adam. With 500+ original stories, our mission is simple: to make bedtime calmer and easier for families. Our videos are intentionally low stimulation, using slow-changing visuals, dark nighttime colours and descriptive storytelling that works as ears-only content. Many stories continue with sleep affirmations, calming meditations and gentle sleep sounds. Children's wellbeing comes before screen engagement. No mid-roll ads, no pressure to keep watching - just thoughtful human storytelling designed to help children close their eyes and sleep. 🏆 British Podcast Awards 2024: Silver, Best Kids Show #BedtimeStories #BedtimeStoriesForKids #KoalaMoon
